verdict.rationale: Unleash documents change requests that require an additional approval step before changes are made in an environment. Up to 10 approvals can be required, changes can be grouped and scheduled, and the GitHub README confirms change requests are an offered feature. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the approval workflow, and explicit detail on how it is scoped to production environments only.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can require approvals or change requests before production flag changes go live

citations.quote: Change requests allow you to require an additional approval step before any changes can be made in an environment.
You can require up to 10 approvals for a change request.
features such as role-based access control, change requests, single sign-on, and SCIM
